topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't stop thinking about the last time I saw Alex, how different everything felt. We used to be inseparable, but now it’s like I'm a complete stranger. It cuts deep, the way their eyes just... don’t recognize. I keep replaying old memories, trying to find a reason why I’ve been erased. Every laugh we shared, every secret we kept, all of it feels like it’s slipping away. I need to know, to understand how something so important can just vanish. What if I’m the only one holding onto this past? What if I’m wrong, and it wasn’t as special as I thought? But deep down, I know it was. I just don’t know how to make Alex see it too.
